description: This Rust source file defines a ConfigSet struct for managing configuration files in memory, including methods for adding files, retrieving integer and string values, and handling resource cleanup. It also includes unit tests for its functionality.

classes.name: ConfigSet
classes.description: An in-memory cache for configuration files, providing methods to load files and retrieve configuration values.

methods.name: add_files
methods.description: Loads multiple configuration files into the ConfigSet, overriding directives as needed.

methods.name: get_int
methods.description: Retrieves and parses an integer value for a given key from the configuration.

methods.name: get_string
methods.description: Retrieves a string value for a given key from the configuration.
